oembed_title: ✅ What does “깜놀” mean? “깜놀” is a Korean slang expression that combines two words: 	•	깜짝 (kkam-jjak) = suddenly / shockingly 	•	놀람 / 놀라다 (nollam / nollada) = surprise / to be surprised So together, “깜놀” = 깜짝 놀람 = “sudden surprise” or “Whoa, that startled me!” It’s like saying: “OMG!” “What the—?!” “That scared me!” “I freaked out!” ⸻ ✅ When do Koreans use it? Usually in fun, casual situations — like when something unexpected happens: 	•	You open a door and someone’s standing right there 	•	A cat
